siteMetadata.title: Alex Morgan — Senior Full-Stack Engineer & UI Architect
siteMetadata.description: Portfolio of Alex Morgan, specializing in high-performance web applications with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern cloud technologies.

personal.name: Alex Morgan
personal.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer & UI Architect
personal.bio: I architect and build lightning-fast, high-converting digital products. With 6+ years of engineering experience across fast-scaling tech companies and high-growth startups, I turn complex requirements into clean, maintainable software that users love.

status.text: Available for Select Contracts & Q3/Q4 Projects

personal.location: San Francisco, CA (Open to Worldwide Remote)

story: I began my journey crafting bespoke frontend interfaces before expanding into scalable cloud backends, API systems, and performance tuning.

Over the past six years, I have collaborated with product founders, venture-backed startups, and established enterprises to transform ambiguous concepts into sleek, enterprise-grade software products that scale effortlessly.
My philosophy centers on three pillars: obsessed user experience, robust clean architecture, and rapid execution without technical debt.

highlights.title: Pixel-Perfect Craftsmanship
highlights.description: Every margin, transition, and micro-interaction is tuned for maximum delight and accessibility.

highlights.title: Production-Tested Architecture

highlights.title: Performance Obsessed

highlights.title: Clear Communication
highlights.description: Transparent milestones, daily updates, proactive problem solving, and zero surprises.

skills.description: Building interactive, accessible, and ultra-smooth client experiences.

experience.description: Engineered customized web applications, SaaS dashboards, and automated client workflows for Fortune 500 brands and high-growth ventures.

Integrated Webhooks, Stripe billing, and automated PDF reporting pipelines
Instituted automated end-to-end tests increasing release stability to 99.9%

experience.description: Collaborated with UI/UX designers to translate Figma design prototypes into fast, responsive, and SEO-optimized web experiences.
achievements: Built over 25 responsive marketing sites and customer portals
Maintained 95+ Google Lighthouse scores across all client deliveries

education.degree: B.S. in Computer Science & Software Engineering

projects.title: Nexus AI — Generative Productivity Suite
projects.tagline: Real-time AI collaboration workspace with streaming responses and vector search.
projects.description: A collaborative enterprise AI platform combining markdown document drafting, voice input, and multi-model AI agent delegation with instant live streaming.
projects.fullDescription: Nexus AI solves the fragmentation between AI chatbots and team documentation. Engineered with Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, Vercel AI SDK, and Supabase pgvector. Features include multi-tenant organization workspaces, custom agent system prompting, PDF semantic indexing, and Stripe tiered subscriptions.
keyFeatures: Real-time token streaming with cancelable requests
Dynamic dark and light high-contrast themes
Team collaborative comments and document versioning
Integrated Stripe monthly and annual checkout flows

projects.title: FinPulse — Wealth & Crypto Analytics
projects.tagline: Real-time financial dashboard with interactive charting and portfolio rebalancing.
projects.description: High-frequency portfolio tracker and institutional analytics suite with live WebSocket tick prices, multi-currency conversion, and tax loss harvesting tools.
projects.fullDescription: FinPulse delivers institutional-grade analytics to independent portfolio managers. Built with a focus on sub-16ms render cycles, custom SVG chart renderers, and zero-latency WebSocket price feeds.
keyFeatures: Interactive candle, line, and volume canvas charts
Automated PDF tax and performance reports generation
Zero-latency multi-exchange WebSocket connection pool
Responsive layout adapted for mobile and 4K displays

projects.title: Lumina — Modern Component Library
projects.tagline: Accessible, open-source Tailwind CSS & React component library.
projects.description: An open-source design system comprising 60+ accessible, fully composable UI components with built-in dark mode and keyboard navigation.
projects.fullDescription: Lumina helps developers launch aesthetic products faster. Written in pure TypeScript with Tailwind CSS and Radix primitives, Lumina achieves 100% WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance and zero runtime CSS bloat.
keyFeatures: 60+ production-ready copy-paste components
WAI-ARIA compliant keyboard focus states
Full support for Tailwind CSS v4 and CSS variables
Interactive Storybook documentation and playground

projects.title: Orbit — Headless E-Commerce Platform
projects.tagline: Lightning-fast shopping experience with Next.js and Shopify Storefront API.
projects.description: A high-conversion headless storefront with instant optimistic cart updates, Algolia instant search, and localized international currencies.
projects.fullDescription: Built to tackle slow loading times on traditional store platforms. Orbit achieves sub-300ms page transitions, reducing checkout abandonment by 28% for international retail brands.
keyFeatures: Optimistic cart drawer with instant quantity calculations
Algolia instant multi-filter search with autocomplete
Multi-currency geolocation pricing selector
Lighthouse performance score of 99/100

projects.title: Zenith — Kanban & Project Workspace
projects.tagline: Minimalist, keyboard-first task manager for remote agile teams.
projects.description: Smooth drag-and-drop workflow system with offline persistence, markdown checklists, and keyboard shortcuts.
projects.fullDescription: Zenith eliminates project management clutter. Crafted with React, Tailwind CSS, and HTML5 drag-and-drop APIs, it allows product teams to organize sprints without touching the mouse.
keyFeatures: Fluid drag-and-drop cards with smooth animations
Full offline support via IndexedDB synchronization
Vim-inspired keyboard navigation and shortcuts
Exportable boards to CSV, JSON, and Markdown

projects.title: Pulse — Mobile-First Wellness Web App
projects.tagline: Health metrics tracking and habits journal for modern wellness seekers.
projects.description: Progressive Web App featuring biometric analytics, streak calculations, and water/sleep reminders.
projects.fullDescription: Pulse combines health telemetry with habit gamification. Designed mobile-first with responsive touch gestures, haptic feedback hooks, and push notifications.
keyFeatures: Installable PWA with offline caching
Interactive streak calendar and milestone badges
Encrypted local health data storage
Smooth micro-animations using pure Tailwind CSS

testimonials.name: Marcus Vance
testimonials.content: Alex delivered our Next.js customer portal 3 weeks before our deadline. The design is breathtaking, the code is meticulously organized, and our users frequently compliment the speed.

testimonials.name: Elena Rostova
testimonials.content: Finding an engineer who truly respects design details is rare. Alex translated our Figma design down to the exact pixel and spacing, then elevated it with smooth, tasteful animations.

testimonials.name: Tariq Al-Mansoor
testimonials.content: The best investment we made for our SaaS MVP. Alex is extremely transparent, writes clean TypeScript, and helped us avoid costly architectural mistakes early on. 10/10 recommendation!
